title: young-planets-resonance: causal re-analysis of near-resonant planet pairs in young planetary systems
description: Code and data for the Research Note Youth Raises the Incidence of Near-resonant Planet Pairs: A Causal Re-analysis. Neighboring planet pairs in the seven transiting multi-planet systems younger than 100 Myr are compared with mature Kepler systems dated by gyrochronology (Bouma et al. 2024) and with mature TESS systems, using g-computation, a system-level permutation test and a negative control placed between low-order commensurabilities. Includes a reproduction of the TTV-free recount of Hansen et al. (2025) updated with the 2026 period of V1298 Tau e and HIP 67522 b/c. Standard-library Python only; NASA Exoplanet Archive snapshot of 2026-11-26.
